next.reason: §2023:14.9.49.4 GR6 restates 'the procedures associated with a USE statement are executed after completion of the standard input-output exception routine upon the unsuccessful execution of an input-output operation unless an AT END or INVALID KEY phrase takes precedence' and items a)-e) word for word. The added preconditions concern an exception-checking PERFORM (2023-only syntax); INVALID KEY does not arise for a sequential file. Dropping 'by the input-output control system' is wording only.
